attchmntText: Setco Automotive Limited has informed the Exchange about reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
desc: Reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
voiceSummary: Setco Automotive Limited has intimated a delay in submitting its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The delay is attributed to additional time required for finalization, review, completion of limited review procedures, and incorporation of financial adjustments to ensure accuracy and regulatory compliance. The company states the delay was neither intentional nor deliberate and regrets the inconvenience. Setco Automotive Limited is making efforts to complete the process and submit the results immediately upon completion. The company remains committed to complying with SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015, and will take measures to avoid recurrence. This intimation is filed under Regulation 33 of the said regulations.
